opening.text: I'm here because I've been getting short of breath when I exert myself and when I lie flat, and I often wake up at night feeling breathless. My legs are swollen, and I get chest tightness on and off. Both of these have been going on for several months; they began after a car accident 5 months ago, in which I hit my chest on the steering wheel.
